academic.uz: CGPA kamida 2.75 bo‘lgan honours bakalavr; CGPA 2.00–2.74 tegishli ish tajribasi bilan qabul qilinadi.

language.en: IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 60; IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 46–59 accepted only with a compulsory academic-English course during the programme.
language.uz: IELTS 6.0 yoki TOEFL iBT 60; IELTS 5.5 / TOEFL 46–59 faqat dastur davomida majburiy akademik ingliz tili kursi bilan qabul qilinadi.

source.name: YÖK — Council of Higher Education (official), 18 June 2026

language.en: An English score is not required to apply. A valid TOEFL, IELTS or METU English exam result at registration exempts you from the preparatory year; IELTS exams taken on or after 24 December 2022 are not accepted. Without a valid score: METU English exam, otherwise one-year English Preparatory Class.
language.uz: Ariza uchun ingliz tili bali talab qilinmaydi. Ro‘yxatdan o‘tishda amal qiluvchi TOEFL, IELTS yoki METU ingliz tili imtihoni natijasi tayyorlov yilidan ozod qiladi; 24-dekabr 2022 va undan keyin topshirilgan IELTS qabul qilinmaydi. Natija bo‘lmasa: METU ingliz tili imtihoni, aks holda bir yillik ingliz tili tayyorlov sinfi.

note.en: Quota international students admitted 2023+; Engineering/Architecture/Sciences 1,200, Econ/Social/Education 800; paid in TL
note.uz: 2023-yildan qabul qilingan kvota xalqaro talabalari; Muhandislik/Arxitektura/Tabiiy fanlar 1 200, Iqtisod/Ijtimoiy/Ta’lim 800; TL’da to‘lanadi

academic.en: Cumulative GPA from diploma (no minimum stated); international applicants usually submit GRE instead of ALES — required GRE mostly around 149–155 (varies by programme).
academic.uz: Diplomdagi umumiy GPA (minimum ko‘rsatilmagan); xalqaro abituriyentlar odatda ALES o‘rniga GRE topshiradi — talab qilinadigan GRE asosan 149–155 atrofida (dasturga qarab).

language.en: A valid English score is mandatory to apply: approx. METU İYS 65–80, TOEFL iBT 79–95, PTE Academic 70–75. IELTS is NOT accepted. Scores valid 2 years.
language.uz: Ariza uchun amal qiluvchi ingliz tili bali majburiy: taxminan METU İYS 65–80, TOEFL iBT 79–95, PTE Academic 70–75. IELTS QABUL QILINMAYDI. Ballar 2 yil amal qiladi.

intake.en: Next graduate application dates: November–December 2026. Tuition discounts of 50% or 100% possible depending on CGPA.
intake.uz: Keyingi magistratura ariza sanalari: noyabr–dekabr 2026. CGPA’ga qarab 50% yoki 100% kontrakt chegirmasi bo‘lishi mumkin.

note.en: All graduate programmes, students starting 2023 Fall or later; evening/joint programmes differ
note.uz: Barcha magistratura dasturlari, 2023-yil kuzidan yoki keyin boshlaganlar; kechki/qo‘shma dasturlar farq qiladi

source.name: YÖK — Council of Higher Education (official), 18 June 2026

note.en: Graduate application fee for overseas payments
note.uz: Chet eldan to‘lov uchun magistratura ariza to‘lovi

language.en: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with Writing 6.5 (or TWE pass) for prep exemption; TOEFL criteria on new 1-6 scale (4.5) from 12 Jun 2026.

note.en: International students; Education/Science/Law 8,000, Econ/Humanities/Engineering/Prep 10,000
note.uz: Xalqaro talabalar; Ta’lim/Fan/Huquq 8 000, Iqtisod/Gumanitar/Muhandislik/Tayyorlov 10 000

academic.en: Diploma and official transcript; YÖK recognition certificate for degrees from abroad; at least two reference letters; statement of purpose and CV (research proposal for some programmes). ALES, or GRE/GMAT instead (not required for some non-thesis master’s).
academic.uz: Diplom va rasmiy transkript; chet el diplomi uchun YÖK tan olish sertifikati; kamida ikki tavsiyanoma; maqsad bayoni va CV (ayrim dasturlar uchun tadqiqot rejasi). ALES yoki uning o‘rniga GRE/GMAT (ayrim tezissiz magistraturada shart emas).

language.en: TOEFL iBT 79 (TWE 22), IELTS Academic 6.5 (Writing 6.5) or CAE grade C; TOEFL/IELTS valid two years.
language.uz: TOEFL iBT 79 (TWE 22), IELTS Academic 6.5 (Writing 6.5) yoki CAE C baho; TOEFL/IELTS ikki yil amal qiladi.

note.en: Graduate: 500 USD per semester; executive programmes differ
note.uz: Magistratura: semestriga 500 AQSh dollari; executive dasturlar farq qiladi

source.name: YÖK — Council of Higher Education (official), 18 June 2026

language.en: TOEFL iBT 72 (pre-21 Jan 2026 scale; 4 on new scale) for undergraduate English courses; else 1-year prep. IELTS not listed. TOEFL iBT 72.
language.uz: Ingliz tilidagi bakalavr dasturlari uchun TOEFL iBT 72 (21-yanvar 2026 gacha bo‘lgan shkala; yangi shkalada 4); aks holda 1 yillik tayyorlov. IELTS ro‘yxatda yo‘q.

note.uz: Ariza oynasi 18-may – 17-iyul 2026 (yopilgan)

academic.en: Programme-specific GPA and ALES/GRE/GMAT minimums; applicants in the international quota may apply without ALES/GRE/GMAT and must meet it within two semesters. Documents: transcripts, statement of purpose, CV, two recommendation letters (uploaded by referees), portfolio if required.
academic.uz: Dasturga xos GPA va ALES/GRE/GMAT minimumlari; xalqaro kvota abituriyentlari ALES/GRE/GMAT’siz topshirishi va uni ikki semestr ichida bajarishi mumkin. Hujjatlar: transkriptlar, maqsad bayoni (SOP), CV, ikki tavsiyanoma (tavsiya beruvchilar yuklaydi), kerak bo‘lsa portfolio.

language.en: English certificate not mandatory to apply for master’s, but admitted students cannot take courses until they submit a valid one (accepted tests per ITU Senate list).
language.uz: Magistraturaga ariza uchun ingliz tili sertifikati majburiy emas, lekin qabul qilingan talaba amal qiluvchi sertifikat topshirmaguncha darslarga kira olmaydi (qabul qilinadigan testlar ITU Senati ro‘yxatida).

note.uz: Magistratura xalqaro arizasi 24-aprel – 26-iyun 2026, 17:00 (UTC+3) — yopilgan; keyingi davr hali tekshirilmagan

scholarships.coverage: 100% tuition exemption + monthly stipend (Master 43,500 TL; PhD 67,500 TL), free dorm, health insurance

note.uz: Bakalavr, qaytarilmaydi, har o‘quv yilida bir marta

note.uz: Ariza oynasi 15-dekabr 2025 – 28-avgust 2026 (yopilgan); 2027 sanalari hali e’lon qilinmagan

academic.uz: Bakalavr diplomi; muhandislik va tabiiy fanlar bo‘yicha tezisli magistratura uchun ALES 65 / GRE-Q 153 / GAT 65; ijtimoiy fanlar ALES 55 / GRE-Q 149 (Political Science yuqoriroq); biznes magistraturalari (MiF, MSBA, MIM…) ALES turidagi imtihon talab qilmaydi.

language.en: TOEFL iBT: 80 (engineering thesis), 78 (non-thesis), 87 (social sciences), 83 (business). IELTS is not accepted (YÖK does not accept its equivalency). Without a valid score: Sabancı English exam or preparation course.
language.uz: TOEFL iBT: 80 (muhandislik, tezisli), 78 (tezissiz), 87 (ijtimoiy fanlar), 83 (biznes). IELTS qabul qilinmaydi (YÖK uning ekvivalentligini qabul qilmaydi). Amal qiluvchi ball bo‘lmasa: Sabancı ingliz tili imtihoni yoki tayyorlov kursi.

note.en: International students, newly admitted graduate students; most academic programme students receive full exemption
note.uz: Yangi qabul qilingan xalqaro magistrantlar; akademik dasturdagi ko‘pchilik talabalar to‘liq ozod etiladi

scholarships.name: Tuition waiver scholarships for international students
scholarships.coverage: 20% to 100% tuition waiver in five levels; accommodation scholarship for some 100% holders

scholarships.name: Merit scholarship (continuing students)
scholarships.coverage: Top 1%-5% of non-scholarship students with GPA 3.30+: 100%/80%/60%/40%/20%

language.uz: IELTS 6.5 (har bo‘limda kamida 5.5) yoki TOEFL iBT 87; aks holda ingliz tili tayyorlov dasturi.

note.en: International students admitted in 2026, incl. 10% VAT; paid in two instalments
note.uz: 2026-yilda qabul qilingan xalqaro talabalar, 10% QQS bilan; ikki qismda to‘lanadi

note.uz: Ariza oynasi 2-fevral – 12-iyul 2026 (yopilgan); 2027 sanalari hali e’lon qilinmagan

academic.uz: Qabul qilinadigan imtihon va diplomlar YTÜ’ning alohida PDF hujjatida; YTÜ o‘z YÖS imtihonini o‘tkazmaydi. Qabul qilinganlar shaxsan ro‘yxatdan o‘tishi kerak.

note.uz: Onlayn ariza 20–31-iyul 2026 (yopilgan)

note.uz: Magistratura qabuli tekshirilmagan.

note.uz: 100% ingliz tilidagi magistratura (≈215 EUR); turkcha / 30% inglizcha: 6 750 TRY. Tekshiruv paytida 2026–27 to‘lovlari YÖK tomonidan hali belgilanmagan

language.en: Programmes fully in a foreign language: B1 Turkish within two years of enrolling. Turkish-taught programmes: C1 Turkish certificate to begin studies.
language.uz: To‘liq chet tilidagi dasturlar: o‘qishga kirgandan keyin ikki yil ichida B1 turk tili. Turkcha dasturlar: o‘qishni boshlash uchun C1 turk tili sertifikati.

note.uz: Arizalar 19–29-iyun 2026 (yopilgan); e’lon paytida 2026–27 to‘lovlari hali belgilanmagan

note.uz: Magistratura qabulini institutlar olib boradi; tekshirilmagan.

who.en: Citizens of MTCP recipient countries (check the official list). Master’s study only.
who.uz: MTCP oluvchi davlatlar fuqarolari (rasmiy ro‘yxatni tekshiring). Faqat magistratura.

criteria.en: CGPA, English, age and country criteria are in the official 2026 guideline, which could not be read here — check it before applying.
criteria.uz: CGPA, ingliz tili, yosh va davlat mezonlari rasmiy 2026 yo‘riqnomasida; uni bu yerda o‘qib bo‘lmadi — ariza berishdan oldin tekshiring.

deadline.en: 2026 cycle: applicants not called for interview by 6 July 2026 are unsuccessful (cycle closed). Next cycle not announced at time of check.
deadline.uz: 2026 davri: 6-iyul 2026 gacha suhbatga chaqirilmaganlar muvaffaqiyatsiz hisoblanadi (davr yopilgan). Tekshiruv paytida keyingi davr e’lon qilinmagan.

notCovered.en: Visa costs and application fees are paid by the applicant.
notCovered.uz: Viza xarajatlari va ariza to‘lovlarini abituriyent o‘zi to‘laydi.

universities.en: Only universities on the MTCP supported list.

who.en: Citizens of listed countries — Uzbekistan is on the 2026 recipient list. Full-time study only.
who.uz: Ro‘yxatdagi davlatlar fuqarolari — O‘zbekiston 2026 ro‘yxatida bor. Faqat kunduzgi ta’lim.

criteria.en: Master’s: bachelor’s CGPA 3.00 / Second Class Upper or higher; age not more than 40 at application (PhD: 45); IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL PBT 550, or an English-taught previous degree. Priority fields include Education, Engineering and ICT (medicine, nursing, pharmacy excluded).
criteria.uz: Magistratura: bakalavr CGPA 3.00 / Second Class Upper yoki yuqori; ariza paytida yosh 40 dan oshmasligi (PhD: 45); IELTS 6.0 yoki TOEFL PBT 550, yoki ingliz tilidagi oldingi diplom. Ustuvor yo‘nalishlar: Ta’lim, Muhandislik, AKT (tibbiyot, hamshiralik, farmatsevtika kirmaydi).

deadline.en: No application dates in the 2026 guideline — check the MOHE portal.
deadline.uz: 2026 yo‘riqnomasida ariza sanalari yo‘q — MOHE portalini tekshiring.

stipendText.en: RM 1,500 per month living allowance (paid every four months after progress reports)
stipendText.uz: Oyiga RM 1 500 yashash nafaqasi (har to‘rt oyda, o‘zlashtirish hisobotidan keyin to‘lanadi)

universities.en: 24 participating universities: 20 public plus UTP, UNITEN, MMU and INCEIF.
universities.uz: 24 ta ishtirokchi universitet: 20 ta davlat universiteti hamda UTP, UNITEN, MMU va INCEIF.

extras.en: University and department placement by the programme; one-year Turkish language course; flight ticket at the start and end of studies.
extras.uz: Universitet va yo‘nalishga joylashtirishni dastur amalga oshiradi; bir yillik turk tili kursi; o‘qish boshida va oxirida aviachipta.

criteria.en: Academic minimum: 70% for bachelor’s, 75% for graduate study, 90% for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy. Age: under 21 for bachelor’s, under 30 for master’s, under 35 for PhD. These are grant criteria, not university entry minimums.
criteria.uz: Akademik minimum: bakalavr uchun 70%, magistratura/doktorantura uchun 75%, Tibbiyot, Stomatologiya va Farmatsevtika uchun 90%. Yosh: bakalavr uchun 21 dan kichik, magistratura uchun 30 dan kichik, PhD uchun 35 dan kichik. Bular grant mezonlari, universitetga kirish minimumlari emas.

stipendText.en: Monthly stipend: TL 6,500 (bachelor’s), TL 9,500 (master’s), TL 13,000 (PhD) — year of these amounts not stated
stipendText.uz: Oylik stipendiya: 6 500 TL (bakalavr), 9 500 TL (magistratura), 13 000 TL (PhD) — summalar yili ko‘rsatilmagan

who.en: Uzbekistan is a partner country: bachelor’s in any available field except Legal Science, Sport Science, Arts and Arts Education; master’s also offered (field restrictions not readable). Applications go through the national sending partner’s nomination.
who.uz: O‘zbekiston hamkor davlat: bakalavr — Huquq, Sport, San’at va San’at ta’limidan tashqari barcha mavjud yo‘nalishlar; magistratura ham bor (yo‘nalish cheklovlarini o‘qib bo‘lmadi). Arizalar milliy yuboruvchi hamkorning nominatsiyasi orqali o‘tadi.

deadline.en: 2026/27 call closed 15 January 2026, 14:00 CET. 2027/28 call not yet checked.
deadline.uz: 2026/27 tanlovi 15-yanvar 2026, 14:00 CET da yopilgan. 2027/28 tanlovi hali tekshirilmagan.

stipendText.en: 2024/25 figures: HUF 43,700 per month (≈EUR 110) for bachelor’s/master’s; free dormitory place or HUF 40,000 per month towards accommodation; supplementary medical insurance up to HUF 65,000 per year. The programme states these do not fully cover living costs.
stipendText.uz: 2024/25 ko‘rsatkichlari: bakalavr/magistratura uchun oyiga 43 700 HUF (≈110 EUR); bepul yotoqxona joyi yoki turar joy uchun oyiga 40 000 HUF; yiliga 65 000 HUF gacha qo‘shimcha tibbiy sug‘urta. Dastur bular yashash xarajatlarini to‘liq qoplamasligini aytadi.

criteria.en: Applies only to the participating EPOS courses. Bachelor’s (normally 4 years) with results in the upper third, normally no more than six years old; at least two years of related professional experience after the first degree; IELTS or TOEFL for English-taught courses (institutional TOEFL not accepted); DSH 2 / TestDaF 4 for German-taught courses. Not more than 15 months’ residence in Germany. This work-experience rule is specific to EPOS, not to all DAAD scholarships.
criteria.uz: Faqat ishtirokchi EPOS kurslariga tegishli. Bakalavr (odatda 4 yillik), natijalar yuqori uchdan birida, odatda olti yildan eski emas; birinchi diplomdan keyin kamida ikki yillik tegishli ish tajribasi; ingliz tilidagi kurslar uchun IELTS yoki TOEFL (institutsional TOEFL qabul qilinmaydi); nemis tilidagi kurslar uchun DSH 2 / TestDaF 4. Germaniyada 15 oydan ortiq yashamagan bo‘lish. Bu ish tajribasi qoidasi faqat EPOS’ga xos, barcha DAAD stipendiyalariga emas.

deadline.en: Deadlines depend on the course (list for 2027/28 published by DAAD). Apply directly to the course, up to three in priority order.
deadline.uz: Muddatlar kursga bog‘liq (2027/28 ro‘yxati DAAD tomonidan e’lon qilingan). To‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kursga, ustuvorlik tartibida uchtagacha ariza bering.

stipendText.en: EUR 992 per month for master’s-level graduates; health, accident and liability insurance; travel allowance; possible rent subsidy and family allowance.
stipendText.uz: Magistratura darajasidagi bitiruvchilar uchun oyiga 992 EUR; tibbiy, baxtsiz hodisa va javobgarlik sug‘urtasi; yo‘l nafaqasi; ijara subsidiyasi va oila nafaqasi bo‘lishi mumkin.

extras.en: One year of Korean language training, then 4–6 years of bachelor’s study. University scholarships or lab funding are not GKS.
extras.uz: Bir yil koreys tili kursi, keyin 4–6 yillik bakalavr. Universitet stipendiyalari yoki laboratoriya moliyalashi GKS emas.

tracks.en: Embassy Track (through Korean embassies, due in September) or University Track (directly at a GKS university, September–November).
tracks.uz: Elchixona treki (Koreya elchixonalari orqali, sentabrda) yoki Universitet treki (to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri GKS universitetida, sentabr–noyabr).

criteria.en: Under 25 in the applicable year; cumulative score 80%+ or top 20% of class or the required CGPA; applicant and both parents non-Korean citizens. These are grant criteria, not university entry minimums.
criteria.uz: Tegishli yilda 25 yoshdan kichik; umumiy ball 80%+ yoki sinfda eng yaxshi 20% yoki talab qilingan CGPA; abituriyent va ikkala ota-onasi Koreya fuqarosi emas. Bular grant mezonlari, universitetga kirish minimumlari emas.

stipendText.en: Airfare, Korean language training, tuition and a monthly allowance (amounts in the GKS guide).
stipendText.uz: Aviachipta, koreys tili kursi, kontrakt va oylik nafaqa (summalar GKS qo‘llanmasida).

tracks.en: Embassy Track or University Track (General, Research, International Organization, R&D, Global Network — the last is master’s-only with no language year). Announcement in February, applications February–March, results in June.
tracks.uz: Elchixona treki yoki Universitet treki (General, Research, International Organization, R&D, Global Network — oxirgisi faqat magistratura, til yilisiz). E’lon fevralda, arizalar fevral–mart, natijalar iyunda.

criteria.en: Under 40; bachelor’s or master’s graduate; GPA at least 80% in the most recent programme; applicant and both parents non-Korean citizens.
criteria.uz: 40 yoshdan kichik; bakalavr yoki magistr bitiruvchisi; oxirgi dasturdagi GPA kamida 80%; abituriyent va ikkala ota-onasi Koreya fuqarosi emas.

stipendText.en: Airfare, Korean language training, tuition and a monthly allowance (amounts in the GKS guide).
stipendText.uz: Aviachipta, koreys tili kursi, kontrakt va oylik nafaqa (summalar GKS qo‘llanmasida).

master.en: A recognised bachelor’s degree, transcripts and suitable academic background. GPA thresholds depend on the university and study mode; 2.75–3.00/4.00 and IELTS 6.0–6.5 are common, but some programmes admit lower GPAs with work experience or extra assessment. Coursework, mixed-mode and research master’s differ: research programmes check your research plan and fit with a supervisor.

GPA chegarasi universitet va o‘qish turiga bog‘liq; 2.75–3.00/4.00 va IELTS 6.0–6.5 ko‘p uchraydi, lekin ayrim dasturlar pastroq GPA’ni ish tajribasi yoki qo‘shimcha baholash bilan qabul qiladi. bachelor.en: You need a recognised school-leaving certificate or an equivalent pre-university qualification, transcripts and subjects that fit the programme. Official general guidelines usually mention 12 years of schooling, so direct entry with Uzbekistan’s 11-year certificate is not automatic: equivalence, a foundation year or another extra step must be checked with the university. For English-taught programmes, preparing for around IELTS Academic 5.5–6.5 is a useful target, but medicine, law, languages and other programmes differ.

Rasmiy umumiy yo‘riqnomalarda odatda 12 yillik ta’lim ko‘rsatiladi, shuning uchun O‘zbekistonning 11 yillik attestati bilan to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri kirish avtomatik emas: ekvivalentlik, foundation yoki boshqa qo‘shimcha ta’lim yo‘li universitetda tekshirilishi kerak. Inglizcha dasturlar uchun IELTS Academic 5.5–6.5 atrofi foydali tayyorgarlik mo‘ljali, lekin tibbiyot, huquq, til va boshqa dasturlarda talab farq qiladi.

master.en: A recognised bachelor’s diploma, transcript, matching field, CV, motivation and references if the programme asks. Thesis and non-thesis master’s differ. ALES, GRE or GMAT, exemptions for international applicants and interviews are set per university/faculty. Check which TOEFL, PTE or university exam an English-taught programme accepts — do not assume IELTS is accepted. There is no single national GPA minimum; aiming for 3.0/4.0 or higher can strengthen an application but is not an official rule.

Inglizcha dastur qaysi TOEFL, PTE yoki universitet imtihonini qabul qilishini tekshiring — IELTS’ni avtomatik mos deb hisoblamang. bachelor.en: School certificate, all school grades, passport and a diploma or exam result the university accepts. English-taught programmes use the university’s own proficiency exam or accepted international tests; Turkish-taught programmes need an accepted Turkish certificate. Denklik hujjati ariza paytida yoki ro‘yxatdan o‘tishda kerakligini tekshiring.

master.en: Bachelor’s diploma, transcript, CV, study plan or research proposal, references the programme requires, and language proof. Til talabi koreyscha va inglizcha dasturga qarab farq qiladi; IELTS 6.0–6.5 yoki undan yuqori tayyorgarlik foydali, lekin aniq shartni manbadan oling.

bachelor.en: Completed recognised schooling, certificate, transcript, proof of the language of instruction, and a personal statement or study plan. Many international tracks ask for documents on the citizenship of the applicant and parents and the family relationship; the exact rule depends on the track. Take apostille/consular rules from the guide. For Korean-taught programmes TOPIK 3–4 can be a starting point for some tracks, but it may be higher. For English-taught programmes, around IELTS 6.0–6.5 is a general target. A recommended score is not a minimum; SAT/AP/IB are not required everywhere.

Inglizcha dasturlar uchun IELTS 6.0–6.5 atrofi umumiy mo‘ljal. Tavsiya qilingan ball — minimal ball emas; SAT/AP/IB hamma joyda majburiy emas.
